info.name: hermiq-code-sandbox
info.summary: Runs short Python and JavaScript programs for Hermiq, isolated
info.description:
hermiq-code-sandbox — optional code sandbox ExApp for Hermiq
Runs short pieces of Python or JavaScript that an agent (`hermiq.runCode`) or a flow's code step (`hermiq.code-step`) sends, and answers their exit code and output. Each run gets a fresh work directory that is removed when it ends, runs as a separate non-root user, and is capped on time, memory, processes and output. The container has no network route out and no data mounts.
Hermiq calls `POST /run` through AppAPI only; the route requires the AppAPI shared secret. See exapp/code-sandbox/README.md for the hardening model.
info.author: Conduction

variable.name: SANDBOX_CONCURRENCY
variable.description: How many runs the sandbox takes at once; more are refused with 429. Default: 2.
